focal_entities.audience: rn's conductor, the AI in the user's Claude Code conversation running rn's skills, whose commands the hook judges and who does what a stop tells it; and whoever maintains rn's hooks, a person or an AI

goal_orientation.purpose: the guard of the session's own branch, already made and tested, holds where git reaches the default branch another way: through `git -C <folder>`, a `cd` earlier in the same command, git led by `env`, `command` or `sh -c`, and in a git worktree the branch checked out there, as .rn/20261013-writ-rebuild/decisions/rn/hooks.decisions.md says under The checks; a conductor stopped by the guard may try the same move another way, and the guard holds only if that way is stopped too; nothing else it does is stopped. The reading of a command stays in common/hooks/shell.py, which turn's hooks share, so turn's no_commit gains what it learns too. The maintainer changing the hooks trusts the tests, run by `sh dev/check.sh rn common turn` and `sh dev/mutate.sh --since <the commit the run starts from> rn common turn`

constraints.environment: the check tools are in the virtual environment first on PATH; `sh dev/check.sh rn common turn` and `sh dev/mutate.sh --since <the commit the run starts from> rn common turn` run as they are, each in seconds to a few minutes; git and a repository made in a temporary folder outside this one are free to use, and git has no identity here, so a commit there takes `git -c user.name=trial -c user.email=trial@example.com`
